paper.title: A Lean formalization of Matiyasevič's Theorem
paper.shortTitle: A Lean formalization of Matiyasevič's Theorem

thesis: In this paper, we present a formalization of Matiyasevič's theorem, which states that the power function is Diophantine, forming the last and hardest piece of the MRDP theorem of the unsolvability of Hilbert's 10th problem.
